summary: Internal C++ hardening of the Toolpath class: commands are stored by value instead of raw pointers, insertCommand/deleteCommand bounds checks are fixed, arc-length and cycle-time computation is corrected (now honoring G90/G91 and G90.1/G91.1), and gtest unit tests are added; no Python API, property, panel, or output format changes.
